Done. The «Сайты» tab is in place, mirroring the Roblox tab pattern.

**What was built**

- **`web-panel.tsx`** (new) — the Websites panel: project picker + settings form for the site (name, theme, style chips from `WEB_PRESET_IDS`, palette, notes, references with upload/remove/previews), group tabs `All / Concepts / Brand / Graphics` (`WEB_CATEGORIES` + `MODE_CATEGORY`, each with its own hint line), 13 mode chips with a hint and placeholder each, a list textarea for `illustrations`/`icons` with a live `N of {max}` counter (`LIST_MODES`/`MAX_LIST`), a takes 1–4 select for single modes (`VARIANT_MODES`/`MAX_VARIANTS`), generation via `gui_generate` with `section: "web"` (the same RPC the Roblox tab uses), and a gallery of the site's jobs grouped per request with thumbs, labels and a make-reference action.
- **`app.tsx`** — `"web"` added to the `Tab` union, a `«Сайты»/«Websites»` nav entry with a Globe icon **right after the Roblox tab**, and a render branch hosting `WebPanel` + the photo viewer. Other tabs' code paths are untouched (diff is purely additive).
- **`i18n.ts`** — 47 new keys, each in **both** en and ru: tab name, group labels + hints, 13 mode labels + hints, placeholders, takes label, list counter, project strings.
- **`tests/web-panel.test.ts`** (new) — asserts every `WEB_MODES` mode and `WEB_CATEGORIES` group has a non-empty en and ru label and hint in i18n.ts; the panel wires every mode; app.tsx registers the web tab after Roblox and renders `WebPanel`; the generate call carries `section: "web"`; the settings render theme, `WEB_PRESET_IDS` chips, `PALETTE_KEYS` palette and references, saved onto the web project; gallery listing; version 0.10.1.
- **`package.json`** — version 0.10.1.

**Verification** — `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/web-panel.test.ts` → 8/8 pass; `npx tsc --noEmit && grep -q '"version": "0.10.1"' package.json` → passes; full `npm test` → 319/319 pass (no regressions in GUI/Characters/Roblox/Model tabs).

APPROACH: Read the Roblox pattern end to end (GuiPanel section mechanics, server `gui_generate` section schema, `save_gui_style`, generation records) before writing; derived the panel's mode table as a `Record<WebMode, …>` so tsc forces all 13 modes; wrote source-level assertions in the style of tests/web.test.ts but made them whitespace-tolerant after the first run showed `api\n  .method(...)` line breaks break literal regexes.

LESSON: Source-regex tests over formatted TSX must not assume `api.method(` adjacency — multi-line member calls are the codebase norm (`api\n      .gui_generate({`), so assert on the call shape (`gui_generate\(\{[^}]*section: "web"`) rather than the receiver.
